note: Judged 2026-10-01 (BGP c20 judge, R58(c)). Row text is a verbatim span of draft -06 Section 1 (lowercase must, ruled to bind the implementation). Gap confirmed at the producers: mpNextHopAddr (rib_bestchange.go) turns the received Next Hop octets into a bare netip.Addr with no zone and no interface, and nothing in the BGP best-change path sets one (no WithZone on that path); on the send side applyLinkLocal (config_nexthop_form.go) parses session link-local as a plain address with no tie to the session's interface. The {gap} annotation states both halves.
